name: Кмітливі пішаки (1)
description:
Pawns are special. They move straight, but take diagonally. And there’s more. As you learned in Pawn level, pawns can be promoted.

Do you remember how that works? If a pawn makes it to the last row, you can change it for a queen, a rook, a bishop or a knight. This change is called 'promotion'. Chess players often use the word ‘queening’ when they promote a pawn to a queen.

The word ‘promotion’ means that something gets a higher value. The little pawn was not very strong. But the new piece is much stronger! More chance for you to win the game!

That’s why we are going to practise with pawns that have nearly made it to the other side.
Usually, it is great to take a stronger piece. However, with pawns on their way to promotion, capturing is not always the best move.

Look at examples 1 and 2. The pawn can take a knight, but he’d better not.
In example 3 promoting to a queen, without capturing first, seems the smartest option. But it isn’t! It will result in being checkmated by Black!

What do you have to do?
Promote a pawn, but do it wisely.

examples.text:
White’s pawn can take the knight and promote to a queen. All in one move. Great! Or is it?

Well... look at the black rook. It stands there waiting to take the new queen. White will still be 2 points better off than before the promotion and exchange. But White can do better!

Look what happens when the pawn goes for a straight promotion, without taking the knight. That’s an 8 point bonus: the 1 point pawn turned into a 9 point queen.
And White has good chances to win the game!

Again, White’s pawn can take the knight. This time, Black can not recapture.
Yet, again, this is not the best move.
Look at Black’s king. He can step to the right.
After promotion, the black king takes the new queen. With only a king on both sides, the game ends in a draw.

The smart thing to do for the white pawn is to simply walk passed the knight.
Now there’s no way Black can block its promotion.
Click on the play button to watch the moves.
White now has a king and a queen. That is much better than Black’s king and knight.
So things are looking good for White.

What should White do? Pass the knight again and go get a queen?
Black cannot recapture. It seems fine, doesn’t it?

Ho, stop! Don’t do it! Black’s rook has a plan!
Do you know what that is? It wants to back rank you!

White has to something to stop Black. What can he do?
Take the knight and turn into a queen.
This new queen puts the king in check.
And Black has to deal with that first.

Black can recapture, but White still has a 2 point win.
Click on the play button to watch the moves.
Things are looking good for White, now.

texts: Choose the best promotion move. Collect as many points as possible.
